note: Live anonymous gene lookup against jMorp. Demonstrates the Hasura-style where/limit argument grammar the whole 305-field query root shares.

body.query: query Gene { gencodeGene(where: {gencodeSymbol: {_eq: "BRCA1"}}, limit: 2) { gencodeGeneIdBase gencodeSymbol gencodeGeneType gencodeLevel hgncId } }
